ABI-001.boundary: Missing identity or binding fields are invalid.
ABI-001.failure: Return INVALID or UNAUTHORIZED without state mutation.
ABI-001.shall: Authenticate the local transport and bind schema version, command, machine, agent, objective, activation, lease fence, generation, activation set, deadline, trace, and evidence references.
ABI-001.trigger: An activation invokes the Agent ABI.

ABI-002.boundary: No handler may execute the semantic command twice.
ABI-002.failure: Return INTERNAL if the ledger is inconsistent and block further execution.

ABI-003.boundary: Provider transcripts are diagnostic evidence only.
ABI-003.failure: Return INCOMPATIBLE and leave durable work resumable.
ABI-003.shall: Preserve agent, objective, command, activation, context-request, and effect semantics.
ABI-003.trigger: A cognition backend or harness is replaced.

ABI-004.failure: No state mutation and no effect admission.
ABI-004.trigger: A client sends an unknown major version or removed v1 semantic.

AUTH-001.boundary: Context, model output, code, package metadata, and possession of credentials are not grants.
AUTH-001.shall: Authenticate the subject and evaluate a current scoped grant at the action boundary.
AUTH-001.trigger: A capability invocation or effect is proposed.

AUTH-002.boundary: A child cannot exceed any parent bound.
AUTH-002.shall: Only reduce operations, targets, duration, quotas, delegation depth, and generation scope.

AUTH-003.boundary: No new consequential operation may use stale authority.
AUTH-003.failure: Fail closed; reconcile in-flight effects according to their state.
AUTH-003.shall: Prevent new invocation within the configured propagation bound and preserve in-flight history.
AUTH-003.trigger: A grant is revoked or authority state becomes stale or unavailable.

AUTH-004.boundary: No ambient credentials or bypass path may exist in activation context or environment.
AUTH-004.failure: Deny and emit an attributed security observation.
AUTH-004.shall: Mediate access through an explicit generic capability endpoint and Linux enforcement.
AUTH-004.trigger: A component requests credentials, network, device, storage, or external effect access.

CORE-002.boundary: Human authority is invoked only by an explicit policy requirement.
CORE-002.failure: Enter BLOCKED_AUTHORITY only when required authority is absent; do not require login for routine operation.
CORE-002.shall: Continue admitting wakes, activations, bounded capability use, effect reconciliation, recovery, and completion.

CTX-001.boundary: Context cannot grant authority or assert completion.
CTX-001.failure: Return explicit MISSING, CONFLICT, STALE, or UNAVAILABLE context status.
CTX-001.shall: Accept a semantic ContextRequest containing unknown, blocked decision, causal hypothesis, freshness need, and evidence type; return a bounded ContextBundle.
CTX-001.trigger: An activation lacks information needed for a decision or causal diagnosis.

CTX-002.failure: Exclude the item or return MISSING provenance.
CTX-002.shall: Bind origin, capture time, effective time, digest, trust classification, freshness state, and source position.
CTX-002.trigger: A context item is admitted to a bundle.

CTX-003.boundary: The compiler cannot silently select a winner.
CTX-003.failure: Block the dependent decision until resolved or explicitly bounded.
CTX-003.shall: Return CONFLICT with both source references.

CTX-004.boundary: No infinite mandatory reasoning process or universal behavior tree is imposed.
CTX-004.failure: Record the hint and continue only within remaining authority and evidence bounds.
CTX-004.shall: Emit a metacognitive context-fault hint while allowing the cognition backend to decide whether to request additional context.
CTX-004.trigger: Repeated failure, changed assumptions, missing evidence, or low-confidence diagnosis is observed.

EFFECT-001.boundary: Cognition and generated code cannot call providers around the effect boundary.
EFFECT-001.shall: Represent it as a durable Effect before provider dispatch.
EFFECT-001.trigger: An operation can change state outside the authoritative transaction or produce consequential output.

EFFECT-002.boundary: An idempotency key identifies intent, not an attempt.
EFFECT-002.failure: Reject or return the existing effect.
EFFECT-002.shall: Atomically evaluate authority, validate preconditions, and reserve a semantic idempotency key before dispatch.

EFFECT-003.boundary: Blind retry as a new effect is prohibited.
EFFECT-003.failure: Block dependent completion and continue bounded reconciliation.
EFFECT-003.shall: Transition to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and then RECONCILING.
EFFECT-003.trigger: Transport, timeout, or executor loss occurs after dispatch without independent outcome evidence.

EFFECT-004.boundary: Admitted class cannot exceed provable reconciliation and evidence behavior.
EFFECT-004.failure: Reject provider admission or effect class.
EFFECT-004.shall: Declare reconciliation mode and record request digest, dispatch time, provider, transport identity, response, observation source, and classification.
EFFECT-004.trigger: A provider is registered or an effect attempt executes.

EFFECT-005.failure: Keep the objective incomplete and expose the blocking effect.
EFFECT-005.shall: Represent compensation as a new independently authorized effect and deny completion while required effects are nonterminal or unknown.
EFFECT-005.trigger: Compensation or objective completion is requested.

EXEC-001.boundary: Only canonical generic execution profiles are core.
EXEC-001.failure: Reject activation if the profile cannot enforce declared bounds.
EXEC-001.shall: Create a private workspace, explicit read-only inputs, bounded outputs, resource quotas, and default-deny network.

EXEC-002.boundary: Termination cannot assert failure of a dispatched effect.
EXEC-002.shall: Revoke runtime access, fence leases, retain required evidence, and classify dispatched effects independently.
EXEC-002.trigger: An activation is cancelled, expires, crashes, or is terminated.

EXEC-003.boundary: Harnesses are adapters, not principal types, execution kinds, or authority planes.
EXEC-003.failure: Deny activation or terminate the adapter.
EXEC-003.shall: Use the normalized cognition contract and have no direct authority, secret, or external-effect path.
EXEC-003.trigger: A cognition or harness adapter executes.

PKG-001.boundary: Package kinds are canonical generic execution profiles only.
PKG-001.shall: Verify immutable digest, signature, provenance, SBOM, dependency closure, requested authority, resources, execution profile, ABI compatibility, state migration, and live verification contract.

PKG-002.failure: Keep the prior set active or roll back.
PKG-002.shall: Create an immutable digest-addressed activation set and bind activations to it.
PKG-002.trigger: A package set activates or upgrades.

PKG-003.failure: Reject and record a scope violation.
PKG-003.shall: Reject additions to principal kinds, effect classes, authority semantics, execution profiles, hardware profiles, or release gates.
PKG-003.trigger: A package attempts to introduce core semantics.

SCOPE-001.boundary: Prior projects, examples, vendors, domains, assistant preferences, implementer preferences, and v1 behavior are non-authoritative.
SCOPE-001.failure: Reject the change before build; do not create a normative artifact.
SCOPE-001.shall: Admit the semantic only when it maps to an allowed core concept and has an admissible source reference.
SCOPE-001.trigger: Any core requirement, type, state, dependency, test, fixture, generated artifact, or build output is introduced or changed.

SCOPE-002.boundary: Renaming, conditional disabling, deprecation, tombstoning in active code, or wrapping the contaminated implementation does not satisfy deletion.
SCOPE-002.failure: Mark the unit DELETE_AND_REBUILD and block integration.
SCOPE-002.shall: Delete the unit and rebuild it only if a v2 requirement requires replacement behavior.
SCOPE-002.trigger: A repository unit contains any prohibited core semantic.

SCOPE-003.boundary: No in-place correction of a released contract is permitted.
SCOPE-003.shall: Reject mutation and require a new semantic version and new content digest.
SCOPE-003.trigger: A binding v2.0.1 contract file is changed.

STATE-001.boundary: History mutation and duplicate semantic execution are prohibited.
STATE-001.failure: Rollback the transaction and return the original disposition for duplicates.
STATE-001.shall: Commit current state and append-only transition history atomically under a stable command identity.
STATE-001.trigger: A command or state transition is admitted.

STATE-002.boundary: Expired or superseded lease holders cannot commit.
STATE-002.failure: Reject stale fences and requeue eligible work.
STATE-002.shall: Persist wake eligibility atomically and use monotonic fencing tokens for leases.
STATE-002.trigger: A wake is created or an activation lease changes.

STATE-003.boundary: Unknown or rejected records cannot be coerced into v2.
STATE-003.failure: Rollback migration or quarantine the record; keep v2 inactive.
STATE-003.shall: Preserve a consistent transactional state and evidence recovery point with explicit forward, rollback, and interruption behavior.
STATE-003.trigger: A schema migration, backup, or restore runs.

STATE-004.boundary: A stale projection cannot represent itself as current truth.
STATE-004.failure: Return STALE or read authoritative state.
STATE-004.shall: Return source position and freshness and remain non-authoritative.
STATE-004.trigger: A projection or index answers a query.

SYS-004.boundary: Only canonical generic profile identifiers are allowed in core.
SYS-004.failure: Reject the profile or reject work requiring an absent feature.
SYS-004.shall: Declare pinned kernel, firmware, drivers, capacity, supported execution profiles, enforceable isolation, and explicit absences.

VERIFY-001.boundary: Compilation, process health, schema validity, mocks, or handwritten evidence cannot prove runtime behavior.
VERIFY-001.failure: Mark the packet or release NOT_COMPLETE.
VERIFY-001.shall: Require objective live evidence for every applicable gate and protected independent evidence for consequential claims.
VERIFY-001.trigger: A work packet or release claims completion.
